content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "This judge text makes an UNDERDETERMINED finding rest on Matthew 1:16 not stating a verdict in either direction and on neither text stating the contrary, which is the kind of ground the rule governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D1 vs C3 (Matthew 1:16): UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē states no verdict on the begetter in either direction, and the defender answered Luke 1:27, Luke 2:4 and Numbers 1:2 in [CR2] section A.3 and [CR3]; the verb change is real [L1]/[L2] but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
